pending_replies.subject: Re: //A21072705//Need AMC price - Moscow - new opportunities between Zion Tech Group and TechSub
pending_replies.body:
Hi Rimpy,

Thanks for the opportunity to have worked together on this project — I really enjoyed it, and I'd like to propose a few practical next steps that can benefit both TechSub and Zion Tech Group:

• A lightweight joint pilot focused on measurable cost savings or new revenue
• A co-branded AI-readiness or security assessment to generate leads for both sides
• A partner/referral model with shared upside on ongoing services

If any of these sound useful, I'm happy to keep advancing this by email, and I'm also available for a short call if that's easier. You can pick a time here: https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup

You can also explore our free tools and new AI services on our website: https://ziontechgroup.com

Best,
Kleber Garcia
CEO, Zion Tech Group
+1 302 464 0950
